'The master of suspense'
Freida McFadden

'A thriller so scary, you won't be able to sleep at night!'
The New York Times

-----------------------------------

Some lies can save you. Some lies can break you...

Twenty-five years ago in a small beachside town, a charming drifter met three inseparable teenage girls - Barb, Lorelei and Nicolette - at Wonderland, the local amusement park. Days later, Lorelei was found dead in a flooded bog.

Now, Wonderland - infamous site of The Carnival Killer's murders - is about to reopen, revitalizing the dying town.
Barb and Nicolette have moved on. But when The Carnival Killer recants his confession and a new body washes ashore, the truth about what really happened to Lorelei threatens to tear the town apart.

-----------------------------------------------------------

S. A. Cosby
